description: Rebuilt from Joseph's feedback (finding 1 and 26, 2026-11-25); his saved file was not found. A plate inside a hollow enclosure moves left at 20 m/s into the carbon-skinned aluminium panel, clamped at its base. The spring he used between plate and enclosure is left out. AS HE BUILT IT: the plate at the old editor maximum (4 MPa, 2500 kg/m3, rubber-soft) and the enclosure on the old default demo material with the lowest crack resistance (0.5 J/m2).

energySource.citation: Structural epoxy G_IC 466.5 J/m², average of the two closest of 250 (Betamate 73455, Martiny et al. 2013), 683 (round-robin TDCB on aluminium, Blackman et al. 2003) and 1250 J/m² (ESP 110, Martiny et al. 2013). Strength 31 MPa is 3M DP460 overlap shear on etched aluminium, used as a stand-in for opening strength.
energySource.caution: Experimental; epoxy toughness varies widely with formulation and bond thickness.
